expectedPrice.description: The close the confirmation showed, as a plain decimal string such as "70600.0000" or "70600". Compared with the stored close as a number.

expectedPriceDate.description: The trade date of that close, YYYY-MM-DD.

expectedFxRate.description: The USD rate the confirmation showed, as a plain decimal string such as "1384.5000"; null for a won security. Compared as a number.

expectedAsk.description: The best ask the review showed, a whole-won decimal string such as "70100".
